scope.evidence: H1 'Build a Donation Receipt Form That Writes the Receipt for You'; hero 'Build a donation receipt form that turns each logged gift into a numbered receipt, saved in a database you own.' (D1 ok); how-to description one sentence, D2 ok.

intent.evidence: Searchers want what a receipt must say and a form that produces it: FAQ 3 'What should a donation receipt form collect?' and tabs 1-3 quote the IRS acknowledgment contents (org name, cash amount, goods description with no value, no-goods statement, quid pro quo estimate); 7-step how-to; four gift types.

specificity.evidence: Receipt 2026-0418, a $400 check at Tamarack Valley Food Bank, a sofa and 2 bookcases at the dock, $150 gala seat with a $60 dinner, 12 x $30 = $360 statement; table uses form variant.

openers.evidence: Feature bodies open on verbs or full sentences: 'Describe the receipt your office sends', 'Pick cash or check and the form asks', 'Connect the Stripe account'.

craft.evidence: Two ', so' endings (steps 4, 5) under the limit; noted only.

voice.evidence: Plain product verbs, concrete detail ('Start the series at the number your paper receipt book would have used next'); no AI tells found.

truth.evidence: IRS statements match their quoted irs.gov spans with no widening and no tax-deductibility claim; but the review step contradicts itself across fields: feature_5 'Gifts of goods and gala tickets post a Slack message ... saying a receipt is waiting' and howto_step_6 'Those wait in a review list' vs tab image 2 'Goods receipt sent' + 'Save and send receipt', mockup donatedGoods 'Email the donor a receipt that lists the items, and post a Slack message', tab image 3 '5 gala receipts sent' and mockup galaTickets 'When a guest buys a seat, email a receipt'.

distinct.evidence: Receipting after the gift (numbering, in-kind descriptions, quid pro quo estimate, year-end statement); does not headline donation request, paypal or stripe donation, which are linked as FAQ anchors only.

faq.evidence: 10 on-topic questions, no brand or file-format ask, hub link in item 2, sibling links 'paypal donation form' and 'stripe donation form', answers answer first, FAQ 5 matches the IRS solicitation-or-receipt span.

images.evidence: Numbers agree with copy ($400 vs $250 rule, $150/$60 vs $75, 12 x $30 = $360 with 4 x $90), one hero per panel, Slack line carries no names or amounts; the sent-vs-waiting status conflict is recorded under truth.

findings.quote: Gifts of goods and gala tickets post a Slack message to your development channel saying a receipt is waiting, with a link to the record.
findings.issue: The page tells two incompatible stories about when goods and gala receipts go out. feature_5 says goods and gala-ticket receipts wait for a person (title 'A heads-up when a receipt needs a person'), and howto_step_6 says goods receipts 'wait in a review list' while 'Every other receipt is sent as soon as the gift is saved' (FAQ 6 also: 'Staff check the description before the receipt is sent'). Every other field shows those receipts sent at once: tab image 2 hero 'Goods receipt sent' with button 'Save and send receipt' and, in the same card, 'Slack: a receipt is waiting, with a link' (sent and waiting at once); mockup donatedGoods 'Email the donor a receipt that lists the items, and post a Slack message to our team'; tab image 3 mini '5 gala receipts sent' and every row 'Sent'; mockup galaTickets 'When a guest buys a seat, email a receipt'; tab_content_3 'Every gala receipt states the $60 estimate beside the price paid.'
findings.fix: Pick one flow and apply it in every field. Simplest: feature_5 covers only receipts held for review (e.g. goods a volunteer described at the dock), drop gala tickets from it, and make the Slack text say a goods receipt is waiting for review. Then either redraw tab 2 as held for review (hero 'Goods receipt waiting for review', button 'Save for review', Slack line kept; mockup donatedGoods says the receipt waits for a staff check before it is emailed), or keep tab 2 as sent and remove the Slack 'waiting' line from image and mockup. Leave tab 3 gala receipts sent on purchase.

findings.quote: Start the series at the number your paper receipt book would have used next, so the records run on without a break.
findings.issue: ', so' tacked-on ending; second instance in howto_step_5_des 'Connect the payment account your website gifts go through, so each completed payment creates a gift record.'
findings.fix: Split into two sentences where it reads better.

findings.issue: 'gift' 21 times and 'gifts' 13 times outside the FAQ (QC Q9); the page leans on one noun.
findings.fix: Vary with donation, check, payment where the meaning holds.

findings.issue: None of the three table competitors ranks in this page's top 10 (QC K7); the SERP is template sites.
findings.fix: Accept: the library has no receipt-template vendors; revisit if one is added.

findings.quote: Void the receipt and issue a new one with the next number in the series.
findings.issue: Correction procedure (FAQ 8) is practice advice with no source; acceptable as a recommendation, not stated as an IRS rule.
findings.fix: None needed; keep it framed as practice.
